oauth_application.description: Enter your SolarEdge developer application credentials here. Home Assistant stores them in its native Application Credentials registry, then opens secured SolarEdge sign-in and consent. Register your Home Assistant external HTTPS URL followed by /auth/external/callback/solaredge as the callback. No refresh token is needed. Existing entry, site and history are preserved.
oauth_application.title: SolarEdge V2 OAuth application

reauth_confirm.description: Renew access to the same site with SITE_DATA and DEVICE_DATA scopes. Basic V2 supports lifetime and calendar energy, directional daily energy, inventory and observed daily battery counter deltas. Average power is a separate 15-minute sample polled every two hours, not instantaneous. Unsupported current readings and their history remain unchanged.
reauth_confirm.title: Authorize SolarEdge Basic V2

data.use_oauth: API version: V2 OAuth ON / deprecated V1 OFF

reconfigure.description: Update site {site_id}. Official Basic V2 replaces the API key while retaining entry and history: daily lifetime, four-hourly calendar energy and battery counter deltas, weekly site and inventory data, and a separate 15-minute average power sample every two hours. Current power, flow directions and battery percentage do not have equivalent Basic readings. Web module credentials are retained.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SolarEdge

user.description: Provide the site ID and choose official Basic V2 OAuth. Lifetime energy is daily; calendar energy and daily battery deltas update every four hours; inventory and site metadata weekly. A separate 15-minute average power sample updates every two hours. Instantaneous power and current battery percentage are not replaced by averages. Leave legacy credentials unchanged when migrating.
